content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how to configure the HTTP [url] for streaming in [product_name]? After trying for two days to connect one of my IP cameras, I'm feeling stuck. Any advice would be appreciated.

Hello, have you tried using VLC? Did you use the correct RTSP address for your camera? Have you attempted converting the RTSP address to an HLS address? Also, check if the port is not in use multiple times, and make sure the video output type in VLC is correctly chosen.

Hello, thank you for replying. The RTSP protocol works in VLC, but using the same URL does not function in [product_name]. For example: rtsp://admin:[user_name]@192.168.1.38:554/h264Preview_01_sub. I'll try your suggestion to convert it to HLS and let you know the result.

Hello again, the stream is working through the VLC server. It's not the ideal solution since having an extra app running just to stream video isn't the best approach in my opinion. I'm not sure why [company_name] has not made RTSP protocol compatible here. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties when trying to directly stream from an IP camera to [product_name], despite successful streaming with VLC. The workaround of using an extra VLC server to convert or relay the stream works, but is not considered convenient. There’s noticeable frustration regarding the lack of native RTSP protocol support in the product, pointing to a gap between what users expect and what is currently supported.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to natively support RTSP streams from IP cameras, enabling direct configuration and viewing without the need for third-party applications.
